summary.text: Miguel Vasquez is the Republican candidate for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 126, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces incumbent Jacklyn Rusnock (D).
Ballotpedia lists him as a former at-large member of the Muhlenberg School District board and a 2024 candidate for Pennsylvania State Senate District 11.

paragraphs.text: Vasquez previously held an at-large seat on the Muhlenberg School District board, according to Ballotpedia.
He ran in the April 23, 2024 Republican primary for Pennsylvania State Senate District 11, losing to Lisha Rowe, 76.2 percent to 23.0 percent.
He advanced from the May 19, 2026 Republican primary for the House seat with 98.3 percent of the vote.
